# Dreamify
> AI Data Visualization platform. Turns raw business data from Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, TikTok Ads, AppsFlyer, Firebase, Stripe, Google Sheets, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and Snowflake into decision-ready dashboards in minutes. Built for marketers, sellers, and founders at SMEs. Pricing: Sandbox free, Pro $15/mo, Team $18/seat/mo.

## Core
- [Homepage](https://app.dreamify.dev/): Product overview and CTA
- [Landing page](https://app.dreamify.dev/landingpage): Full positioning, connectors, workspace agents, pricing
- [About](https://app.dreamify.dev/about): Mission, problem, features
- [Pricing](https://app.dreamify.dev/pricing): Sandbox / Pro / Team tiers
- [Docs](https://app.dreamify.dev/docs): How Dreamify works

## Product
- [Data Connectors](https://app.dreamify.dev/product/data-connectors): Live connectors for AI dashboards
- [Workspace Agents](https://app.dreamify.dev/product/workspace-agents): Dreamify inside Slack, Telegram, Zalo, WhatsApp
